scripts.build: vp run --filter @mosoo/agent-driver build && vp run --filter @mosoo/web build
scripts.check: vp run -w fmt:check && vp run -w docs:check && vp run -w lint && vp run -w tc && vp run -w test && vp run -w public-api:contract:check
scripts.deploy: vp run -w deploy:api && vp run -w deploy:web
scripts.fmt: vp fmt --write config scripts vite.config.ts justfile apps/api apps/web pkgs e2e --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.fmt:check: vp fmt --check config scripts vite.config.ts justfile apps/api apps/web pkgs e2e --ignore-path .gitignore
scripts.lint: vp run -w cf:types && vp lint vite.config.ts config scripts apps/api apps/web pkgs e2e
scripts.public-api:contract:check: vp run -w public-api:openapi:check && vp run -w public-api:breaking:check
scripts.tc: vp run --filter @mosoo/agent-driver build:types && vp run -r tc
scripts.test: vp exec bun test ./config ./scripts && vp run --filter '!mosoo' test && vp run -w graphql:codegen:check
